name: Mitsudomoe ~Shiroki Keiyaku to Hajimari no Kangoku~
original_name: ミツドモエ～白き契約と始まりの監獄～
source:
One day, ___ met a certain person, who led to others. 

Together they came to a place. 

It was a place where sinners could live in joy. 

"What do you think of this crime?" 

-------------------------------------------------------- 

5 bad endings. 
Please be prepared for this. 
Yet, each ending has a silver lining. 

The one with lost memories, the one who laughs in the face of misery, 
the one with an oni's spirit, the promise keeper, the lost soul, 
the one who clings to the last vestiges of hope. 

Each meets a different end. 
If you have an interest, definitely continue.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE126830.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某天，___遇见了某个人，而那个人又引出了其他人。

他们一同来到了某处。

那是一个罪人可以快乐生活的地方。

“你怎么看这桩罪行？”

--------------------------------------------------------

5个坏结局。
请做好心理准备。
但每个结局都有一线希望。

失去记忆的人、面对苦难放声大笑的人、
拥有鬼之魂的人、信守承诺的人、
失落的灵魂、紧抓最后一丝希望的人。

他们各自迎来了不同的结局。
如果你感兴趣，就一定要继续下去。
